author_positions.quote: The Theology Wiki finds no conflict with Maimonides, nor conflict with Hasidic Judaism, it bridges the gap between both.
We pray, natural events happen, and if we interpret those natural events as being the answer to our prayers then it's a theologically valid conclusion that God has answered our prayers.

bridge-integral.title: Corey deVos, Pre/Trans Fallacy, Integral Life

bridge-enoch14.title: First Enoch 14, R. H. Charles translation
bridge-enoch14.scope: Primary text in older translation; dream and vision frame. Not a collation of Qumran fragments.

bridge-genesis.title: Genesis 28:12-17, Mechon Mamre

bridge-leviticus.title: Leviticus 19:26-34, Mechon Mamre

bridge-numbers.title: Numbers 11:25-29, Mechon Mamre
bridge-numbers.scope: Hebrew-English passage on the elders, Eldad and Medad; no composition date inferred.

bridge-deuteronomy.title: Deuteronomy 13:2-6, Mechon Mamre numbering
bridge-deuteronomy.scope: Hebrew-English passage on signs and authority. Numbering differs in some Christian editions; ancient penalty is not endorsed.

bridge-joshua.title: Joshua 3:13-17, Mechon Mamre
bridge-joshua.scope: Hebrew-English passage on Jordan crossing; no natural mechanism or composition date independently verified.

bridge-judges.title: Judges 6:36-40, Mechon Mamre
bridge-judges.scope: Hebrew-English passage on fleece and dew; not an experimentally verified sign-seeking method.

bridge-samuel.title: First Samuel 10:5-6, Mechon Mamre
bridge-samuel.scope: Hebrew-English passage on musical instruments and prophecy; not a measured brain-state account.

bridge-kings.title: First Kings 19:11-13, Mechon Mamre
bridge-kings.scope: Hebrew-English passage distinguishing the encounter from wind, earthquake and fire.

bridge-jeremiah.title: Jeremiah 23:23-28, Mechon Mamre
bridge-jeremiah.scope: Hebrew-English passage on presence and deceptive claims to dreams; no composition date inferred.

bridge-ezekiel.title: Ezekiel 1:26-28, Mechon Mamre
bridge-ezekiel.scope: Hebrew-English passage on appearance, likeness and glory; no exclusive philosophical interpretation asserted.

bridge-song.title: Song of Songs 8:6-7, Mechon Mamre
bridge-song.scope: Hebrew-English poetry of love; later spiritual application distinguished from original intention.

bridge-ruth.title: Ruth 2:8-12, Mechon Mamre
bridge-ruth.scope: Hebrew-English passage on practical care and refuge under God's wings; proposed connection is interpretive.

bridge-lamentations.title: Lamentations 3:21-26, Mechon Mamre
bridge-lamentations.scope: Hebrew-English passage on grief, remembered hope and compassion; no general victim-blaming inference.
